subject.title: Harden web sync: identity guard for collections, structured job logging, configurable transport mode

question: Should Birdclaw permanently expose `BIRDCLAW_WEB_SYNC_MODE` as a supported operator-facing transport override, rather than retaining automatic transport selection as the only supported behavior?
rationale: The account guard is a narrow safety repair, but the environment variable creates a durable configuration and support contract that source inspection alone cannot approve.

options.title: Approve a narrow transport override
options.body: Keep `bird` and `xurl` as explicit opt-in values, document default `auto` behavior and operator recovery, and require real-service proof before merge.

options.title: Keep automatic selection only
options.body: Split out the identity and logging hardening, and drop the new environment variable until a broader transport-configuration design is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow transport override
recommendation.body: Keep `bird` and `xurl` as explicit opt-in values, document default `auto` behavior and operator recovery, and require real-service proof before merge.
